2.en:
Brief — last 2 hours

  • Active strikes: IDF striking in southern Lebanon near Ridge Ali al-Taher, Kafr Tabnit and Qantara (report at 12:44 UTC).
  • Northern Border: Ongoing IDF ground/air strikes reported in south Lebanon (see above).
  • Gaza: Reported Israeli UAV strike on a jeep at the entrance to Al Shifa hospital in western Gaza. Reports cite one killed and several wounded; two missiles hit the vehicle.
  • Maritime / Strait of Hormuz: Iran’s IRGC Navy claims it targeted two oil tankers using an “unauthorized southern route,” setting both vessels on fire (11:46 UTC).
  • Missile activity: Houthi militias launched two ballistic missiles toward Mecca; air defenses intercepted them and debris fell near Sabuha, ~35 km from Mecca (11:58 UTC).
  • Air / ISR: A U.S. MQ-9A Reaper was observed over Baghdad, Iraq (12:03 UTC).
  • Political / Threats: Iranian officials warned U.S. bases in Europe would be struck in any war; multiple media outlets reported and analyzed this threat (12:44–12:49 UTC). Israeli media report PM Netanyahu planning new decapitation strikes on Iranian leaders (11:18 UTC).
  • Commentary items: Media analyses and opinion pieces published (Al Jazeera, Reuters, Times of Israel) — informational only.
  • Threat trend: Escalating. Multiple-domain attacks and explicit cross-border threats within the same timeframe.
  • 🟢 Good News: Houthi-launched ballistic missiles toward Mecca were intercepted by air defenses.

  • Other notable items: Palestinian channels report an Israeli UAV strike on a jeep at Shifa hospital entrance; local reports of demolition of a \"shaheed\" monument in the Ramallah area.
  • Threat trend: Escalating — simultaneous kinetic strikes, maritime attacks, missile launches and explicit threats to overseas bases and leaders.
  • 🟢 Good News: Ballistic missiles toward Mecca were intercepted. IDF publicly reports a successful strike on a Hamas brigade commander hiding in a hospital.

24.en:
Situation Report (selected events, last 24h)

  • Active strikes/attacks: IDF reported strikes in south Lebanon near the Ali al-Taher ridge, the village of Tebnit and Kantra (reported ongoing). IDF/ISA and IDF social posts state a strike at Nasser Hospital in Khan Yunis hit Hamas’ Khan Yunis brigade commander Muhammad Abu Ismail and additional militants. Media report ~6 killed. An Israeli drone exploded over Mefdoun (Lebanon); debris fell into a residential garden.
  • Maritime / Strait of Hormuz: Iran’s IRGC Navy announced it targeted two oil tankers using an "unauthorized southern route"; both vessels caught fire and were reported disabled/exploded by IRGC/TASS/Reuters.
  • Missiles & launches: Reports of ballistic missile launches from Hamadan Province and other Iranian launches. Houthi militias launched two ballistic missiles toward Mecca; air defenses intercepted them and debris fell near Sabuha ~35 km from Mecca.
  • Threats & rhetoric: Senior Iranian figures warned US bases in Europe would be struck "in any war" (reported). Brig. Gen. Kioumars Heydari publicly threatened to "kill President Trump" (reported). Israeli media reported plans for new decapitation-strike attempts on Iranian leaders (Israel Hayom item on Telegram).
  • US / regional movements: A US MQ-9A Reaper drone was spotted over Baghdad, Iraq.
  • Threat trend: Escalating — multiple cross-domain actions (air/land/sea/missiles) and explicit threats to US bases in Europe.
  • 🟢 Good News: Saudi air defenses intercepted Houthi ballistic missiles toward Mecca. IDF reports elimination of a Hamas brigade commander in the hospital strike.

דוח מצב (אירועים נבחרים, 24 השעות האחרונות)

  • תקיפות/אזהרות פעילות: צה"ל מדווח על תקיפות בדרום לבנון סמוך לרכס עלי א-טאהר, הכפר תבנית וקנטרה (דיווח על התקפה שוטפת). צה"ל/שב"כ פרסמו כי תקיפה בבית חולים נאצר בחאן יונס פגעה במח"ט ח'אן מלבן חמאס, מוחמד אבו אסמעיל, ובמחבלים נוספים. כלי תקשורת מדווחים על כ-6 הרוגים. רחפן ישראלי התפוצץ באוויר מעל מפדון (לבנון), רסיסים נפלו לחצר מגורים.
  • ימי / מצר הורמוז: צי ה-IRGC הודיע כי פגע בשני מכליות נפט שניסו לעבור בדרך דרומית "לא מורשית"; שתי המכליותCatch אש ודווחו כניזוקות/מופצצות (דיווחי IRGC/TASS/Reuters).
  • טילים והשיגורים: דיווחים על שיגורים בליסטיים ממחוז חמדן ודיווחים על שיגורים נוספים מאיראן. חות'ים שיגרו שני טילים בליסטיים לעבר מכה; כוחות הגנה אווירית יירו אותם ומפגעים נפלו בסבוהה כ-35 ק"מ ממכה.
  • איומים ודיבור צבאי: בכירים איראנים הזהירו שתכוונו לבסיסי ארה"ב באירופה במקרה מלחמה. מפקד בכיר הוי אי.אר.ג'סי צוטט שאמר כי "יהרגו את הנשיא טראמפ" (דיווח). תקשורת ישראלית דיווחה על תוכניות לנסות מהלכי חיסול חדשים כנגד מנהיגים איראנים.
  • ארה"ב/אזור: כלי טיס בלתי מאויש MQ-9A של ארה"ב נצפה מעל בגדאד, עירק.
  • מגמת איום: تصاعد — פעולות חוצות זירות (אוויר/יבשה/ים/טילים) ואיום מפורש כלפי בסיסי ארה"ב באירופה.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: ההגנה הסעודית יירטה את טילי החות'ים לעבר מכה. צה"ל מדווח על חיסול מח"ט ח'אן יונס.

48.en:
Situation report — last 48 hours

  • Active strikes / interceptions:
    • IDF/ISA struck Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis. IDF says target was Hamas Khan Younis brigade commander Muhammad Abu Ismail. Media report: 6 killed (Times of Israel).
    • IRGC Navy reports it struck two oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. Reports say both vessels caught fire / were disabled; multiple outlets cite explosions.
    • Houthi militias launched two ballistic missiles toward Mecca; air defenses intercepted them. Debris fell near the village of Sabuha (~35 km from Mecca).
  • Gaza / Southern Gaza
    • IDF statement and multiple media reports confirm strike on Nasser Hospital; IDF frames the strike as targeting a Hamas brigade commander hiding inside the hospital.
    • Palestinian channels report separate Israeli UAV strike on a jeep near Shifa hospital entrance in western Gaza; casualties reported.
  • Maritime — Strait of Hormuz
    • IRGC public claims: two oil supertankers exploded/disabled after being targeted for using an “unauthorized southern route.” Reuters/TASS reported the incidents.
  • Iranian missile / launch activity
    • Reports of two ballistic missile launches from Hamadan Province (western Iran).
    • Senior Iranian figures and outlets issue explicit warnings that US bases in Europe would be targeted in any war.
  • Northern border (Lebanon)
    • IDF activity reported in south Lebanon near Ridge Ali al-Taher, Kafr Tabnit and Qantara.
    • An Israeli drone exploded over Mefdoun; debris fell into a residential garden.
  • US / regional ISR and posture
    • US MQ-9A Reaper drone observed over Baghdad (commercial monitoring report).
  • Media / political notes
    • Israel Hayom (media) reports PM Netanyahu planning another round of alleged ‘‘decapitation’’ strikes on Iranian leaders (media claim).
    • Iranian commanders’ statements in outlets include overt threats and retaliatory rhetoric toward US figures and Western bases.
  • Threat trend: Evidence shows heightened regional kinetic action — multiple strikes, missile launches and maritime attacks reported in the last 48 hours.
  • 🟢 Good News: Houthi-launched missiles toward Mecca were intercepted. IDF/ISA report successful strike on a Hamas commander who was reportedly holding hostages.
